name: SpecBar
blurb: Describe a product idea in a sentence or two. Get back a full spec: personas, competitors, requirements, metrics, risks and launch posts. Downloads as a Word doc.
doodle: dressed as 1985 for no good reason
note: Runs on a free server. If it's been napping, the first load takes about 50 seconds.

name: Tiny Museum
blurb: A daily art quiz: ten famous artworks, guess who made them, then get a short, funny note on each. The notes are written by an AI that looks at every painting, then fact-checked by a second AI pass.
doodle: the AI fact-checker rewrote 60% of the first drafts

name: Draft Room
blurb: A fantasy football mock draft against eleven AI managers, each with a drafting personality and opinions about your picks. Suggests your best pick and grades every team at the end.
doodle: Spreadsheet Steve took a defense in round 8

name: Dice Showdown
blurb: A five-round dice-calling duel in an old Texas saloon. Play Daisy solo, or pass one phone between two players. The winner gets a WANTED poster.
doodle: Daisy talks trash. She's earned it.

name: World Cup Fantasy Optimizer
blurb: Picks a fantasy squad for each World Cup 2026 round using only pre-match info, then checks it against what actually happened.
